content: Nitrofurantoin dosage and administration guidelines are as follows: MacroBID capsules must be taken with food to enhance absorption and reduce gastrointestinal side effects. For adults and pediatric patients aged 12 years and older, the recommended dosage is one 100 mg capsule every 12 hours for a duration of seven days. MacroBID is supplied as 100 mg capsules that are opaque, with a black and yellow coloration. The capsules are imprinted with the text “(Band) MacroBID (Band)” on one side and “52427-285” on the other side. The product is identified by the National Drug Code (NDC) 52427-285-01 and is available in bottles containing 100 capsules. For proper storage and handling, MacroBID should be kept at controlled room temperature, specifically between 59°F and 86°F (15°C to 30°C).
